Matches staged-task-contract.md:66-74 exactly. No ${VAR} literal secret present. test.sh:63-66 refuses to grade without REWARDKIT_JUDGE/REWARDKIT_MODEL (zero reward), and test.sh:207 invokes rewardkit without overriding model, so the judge model comes only from [verifier.env] as required by staged-task-contract.md:178. Judge.toml: all five (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual) have [judge] judge = "claude-code" (line 2) - the expected fallback matching REWARDKIT_JUDGE; grep for model|base_url|api_key|openrouter|glm|reasoning|temperature across tests/*.toml/*.sh/*.py/Dockerfile returns no model setting. Pinned image: task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template tests/Dockerfile (diff empty; also test.sh, .dockerignore, tools/ identical). It pins @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7, chromium from the pinned Playwright MCP's own CLI; bases node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim are tag-pinned (no digest) - template-controlled, identical across tasks, not a task defect. Workbook note: the 'Internal Quality Checks' annotation for #10 still says 'pinned image + allowlist'; the client 'Quality Checks' text, SKILL Delivery profile and quality-checks.md #10 all say network is public and no allowlist is required, so the absent allowlist is correct. Colderwater lessons check: lesson 11 (judge infra crashes such as unrecognized_model zero a dimension) bears on this row - the model string is the unchanged shared value, so any such crash would be harness-wide, not task-caused; lessons 13/25 (no public internet in judge prompts) belong to row 25, not this row. No lesson pattern produces a row-10 defect. Adversarial: a broken app cannot influence this row (verifier wiring is task-static, separate container, /tests chmod go-rwx). A conforming app could only fail through this row if the credential/model were mis-wired; it is not. Out-of-row observation for owner (not graded here): task tests/scored/functional/judge.toml lines 3-4 differ from template (mode = "individual", timeout = 700 vs template batched/9000) - belongs to rows 11/24 and template-preservation review. Evidence limits: static/source review only. raw-evidence-index.json contains only scripted golden runs (hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair); no full configured judge run exists, so the OpenRouter credential/model resolution was not exercised end to end. That runtime gap is owned by the workload/full-verifier evidence rows; the row-10 requirement (unchanged shared block, separate pinned verifier, no judge.toml model) is fully decidable from source and is met.
